news.title: FDA says Novo Nordisk's TV ad for obesity pill includes 'false or misleading' claims
news.description: The FDA requested that Novo take immediate action to address the violations, which could include ceasing all ads containing misleading claims about the pill.

news.title: Databricks completes $5 billion funding round at $134 billion valuation
news.description: Databricks is prepared to go public "when the time is right," CEO and co-founder Ali Ghodsi told CNBC in an interview.

news.title: S&P 500 rises, led by tech; Dow climbs to fresh record: Live updates
news.description: The moves come after the major averages bounced back Friday from sizable losses suffered earlier in the week.
